verdict.rationale: Aider covers the debugging loop with documented tools. `/run` executes code and can share the output with the model to reproduce issues. `/ask`, the repo map and `/map` support investigating the codebase, and community users report it helps explain unfamiliar code. `/test` plus `--test-cmd`/`--auto-test` re-run tests after edits to verify fixes, and `/undo` rolls back failed attempts. Missing for 10: a documented end-to-end root-cause/debugging workflow or debugger integration, and independent hands-on corroboration of reproducing and fixing real bugs.
